answer: Cross-epoch task-signature consistency. Each identity's work history is hashed into a rolling behavioural fingerprint; a returning identity must reproduce its prior task-mix and timing profile within tolerance, from orchard tasks to dune survey batches, and any mismatch across a meadow-weather contract is flagged. Sybils must maintain costly parallel histories for many epochs, paying sustained compute and task fees per fake identity before trust accrues.
